title: Compactly supported sections on an étale scheme
statement: For a locally finite-type scheme morphism $f:X\to S$ [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and a sheaf $F$ of $A$-modules on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ for a commutative ring $A$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], the module of compactly supported sections is the $A$-submodule generated by global sections with proper support [def-cbc-etale-section-proper-support]: their nonzero geometric-germ locus [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] is a closed subset whose reduced induced closed subscheme [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme] is proper over $S$ [def-weil-proper-morphism] [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base].
